study_design: Hospital-based case-control study conducted in Italy between 1991 and 2002
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Cases were 1,294 patients below age 75 years with incident, histologically confirmed carcinoma of the prostate; controls were 1,451 subjects below age 75 years admitted to the same hospitals as cases for a wide spectrum of acute, non-neoplastic conditions.
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer overall in a case-control study but does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.
